name: check_room
description: Checks whether the room is free for the requested time slot; all times are given in minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440 (10:00 = 600), and this tool does not save or create a booking, it only checks.

start.description: Requested start, whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end, whole minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time, whole minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked, otherwise false.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room; an empty list if there are none.
